subject: Corner booth canopy mounting & ADA stepback — permit confirmation
messages:
From: Alejandro Ramos <alejandro@exposervices.com>
To: camila_reyes, marissa_cole, logan_wright
Date: 2028-10-18 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Corner canopy — mounting clearance question

Hi Camila / Marissa / Logan,

Quick one as we prep the rigging plan for booth 28F. The island-corner canopy your team specified will hang 8ft off the finished floor, but the venue is asking for exact mounting points and a 36" ADA clear stepback from the aisle edge. Can you confirm: 

- Are you expecting the canopy to be cantilevered from the corner column or hung from the show truss?
- Do you need us to provision extra rated straps (2" webbing, 1,200 lb rating) vs. the standard 800 lb?
- Any proposed changes to the floorplan that affect the required 36" ADA stepback?

We can hold mounting until we have permit signoff, but want to avoid a late rework if the footprint changes. Attaching our standard onsite spec in the follow-up.

—Alejandro
Alejandro Ramos
Operations Manager
ExpoServices LLC
ops@exposervices.com

From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alejandro Ramos <alejandro@exposervices.com>
Cc: marissa_cole, logan_wright, stephanie_nguyen, karthik_iyer
Date: 2028-10-18 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Corner canopy — mounting clearance question

Thanks Alejandro — good questions. Short answers up front, details below:

- Mounting: we plan to use a corner column build (cantilevered from our custom counter shell) with supplemental overhead straps to the truss for redundancy.
- Straps: please provision the 2" webbing rated 1,200 lb. We want the higher safety margin.
- ADA stepback: we will keep the 36" clear per venue; see new floorplan v3 attached where the demo counter is shifted 6" toward the interior to preserve the stepback.

Requested next steps for your team:
1) Can you confirm the strap hardware (anchors + rated carabiners) you will bring?
2) We need an insurance endorsement listing Redwood Inference and ExpoServices LLC as additional insured for mounting work before onsite inspection.
3) Please hold on physical mounting until the permit is stamped.

Attaching: booth-28F-floorplan-v3.png (updated layout). I will loop Marissa for signoff on the structural notes and Logan for onsite crew coordination.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

On Thu, Oct 18, 2028 at 09:12 AM Alejandro Ramos <alejandro@exposervices.com> wrote:
> Quick one as we prep the rigging plan for booth 28F...

Camila — approved with conditions. The team reviewed the v3 floorplan. Two things to lock before we give the go-ahead:

1) Insurance endorsement: Alejandro, please email the insurance-endorsement-exposervices.pdf showing coverage for rigging and naming Redwood Inference and the Moscone Center (venue) as additional insured. The permit office will not stamp without it.

2) Canopy guidelines: Stephanie, please push the canopy_mount_guidelines.pdf (attached) to the vendor with our required mounting notes (double-redundancy straps, no hard-bolting into shell surfaces without structural signoff).

Logan, plan for an inspection window 8am–10am on load-in day (we'll confirm exact date once DocuSign returns). If the vendor arrives earlier, we need the site marshal to hold them.

If those two items are in place I sign off on the structural approach.

—Marissa

From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@citypermits.gov>
To: marissa_cole, camila_reyes, Alejandro Ramos <alejandro@exposervices.com>
Cc: ExpoServices Onsite <ops@exposervices.com>, logan_wright
Date: 2028-10-19 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Corner canopy — mounting clearance question (permit intake)

Camila / Marissa / Alejandro,

Thanks for the updates. Permit intake review notes below: 

- We require the insurance endorsement PDF showing current coverage and additional insured language — once we have that we can move to permit issuance.
- ADA: the required 36" clear stepback must be unobstructed. The updated floorplan v3 looks OK provided the demo counter is fastened and non-movable during show hours.
- Mounting hardware: venue requires rated anchor points or certified temporary roof-truss straps. The 1,200 lb webbing is acceptable; certified carabiners and stamped hardware specs must be included with the vendor package.
- Inspection: a spot inspection will be scheduled within the 24-hour window after installation. Please have the vendor foreman and the site marshal available.

Once insurance and hardware specs are uploaded we will queue the permit stamp. If you prefer, you can use our secure upload link and reference permit 28F-CANOPY-2028.

Regards,
Janelle Park
Permitting — Moscone Center
janelle.park@citypermits.gov

- Marissa: structural signoff pending receipt of vendor hardware certs (ETA tomorrow).
- Logan: marshal onsite 8am–10am load-in; please confirm crew contact and walkie channel.
